The decision is written to `~/laguna-bench/verify/F1-1/DECISION.md`: **FAIL**. That is for lack of verification, not because the code is shown to be broken.

- **Decisive defects:** Neither verifier submitted a report. Verifier D also left no tests in `tests/verify`, so that part of the plan has no evidence at all.
- **Verifier D trust:** None. There is no report and no tests to check.
- **Verifier P trust:** Low to moderate. With no report there are no claims to compare, but the harness re-run (6 passed) is authoritative and favorable. The run took about 15 minutes (896s), which is unexplained.

Next round, re-run D and have P map its tests to plan items.
